co_stress_diagnostics.below_stress_threshold_rule: family multiplier at or below its registered trough multiplier
co_stress_diagnostics.stress_window: registered onset through the 168-hour recovery interval

B1.beneficial_rule: at least two operational primary solvency advantages have positive means and 95% intervals above zero, with no clearly adverse operational bad-debt metric

branch_map.not_operational: fewer than two primary solvency metrics operational
branch_map.supported: at least two diversified portfolios satisfy the beneficial rule

branch_map.correlation_deterioration_partial: exactly one satisfies, or at least two portfolios have one clearly deteriorating metric
branch_map.correlation_deterioration_present: at least two portfolios satisfy deterioration rule
branch_map.correlation_reversal_present: at least two portfolios have at least two adverse high-correlation advantages; takes precedence
branch_map.not_operational: fewer than two primary solvency metrics operational

B2.deterioration_rule: at least two operational primary solvency deterioration interactions have positive means and 95% intervals above zero, with no material opposite result
B2.material_opposite_rule: interaction mean is negative by at least the frozen metric threshold and its 95% interval is below zero

branch_map.transmission_intensifies: at least two portfolios satisfy all four conditions
branch_map.transmission_invalid: collateral attribution, path or accounting fails
branch_map.transmission_mixed: at least two portfolios satisfy at least two conditions
branch_map.transmission_not_operational: shared capacity never binds and displacement is absent

conditions: ETH and WBTC both show positive unsafe or liquidation activity
at least two families have positive backlog area
at least one collateral has positive shared-capacity displacement
high-correlation simultaneous ETH/WBTC unsafe-hour share exceeds empirical-joint-stress share

operationality.bad_debt_exclusion: degenerate bad-debt outcomes cannot determine B1 or B2
operationality.degenerate_rule: all registered cell values equal within tolerance or every replication has the same value

overall_h3_branch_map.H3_correlation_deterioration_partially_s: B2 partial, or B3 mixed with at least one B2 deteriorating metric
overall_h3_branch_map.H3_correlation_deterioration_supported: B1 supported or partial, B2 deterioration present, and B3 intensifies or is mixed
overall_h3_branch_map.H3_correlation_reverses_diversification: B2 reversal present and B3 valid
overall_h3_branch_map.H3_diversification_robust_to_high_correl: B1 supported, B2 not present, at least two persistence classifications, and B3 valid
overall_h3_branch_map.H3_no_clear_correlated_stress_effect: remaining valid, B3-valid states without clear persistence or reversal

peg_solvency_aggregation.group_state: deteriorates or improves when at least two portfolio-metric interactions are material and their 95% intervals exclude zero; both directions gives mixed; otherwise unchanged

persistence_precedence: not_operational if fewer than two operational metrics
reversed if at least two metrics clearly adverse
weakens_but_remains if at least two remain beneficial and at least two deteriorate
persists if at least two remain beneficial
neutralised if no metric is clearly beneficial or adverse

diagnostic_definitions.binding_hours: post-shock hours with at least one capacity-rejected opportunity
diagnostic_definitions.hours_all_applicable_volatile_families_u: post-shock hours where every positive-exposure ETH/WBTC family is unsafe; ETH-only therefore has one applicable family
diagnostic_definitions.hours_at_least_two_unsafe_families: post-shock hours with at least two unsafe families
diagnostic_definitions.hours_eth_wbtc_simultaneously_unsafe: post-shock hours where both ETH and WBTC are unsafe
diagnostic_definitions.hours_one_unsafe_family: post-shock hours with exactly one unsafe family
diagnostic_definitions.maximum_backlog_duration: longest post-shock run of positive system unresolved tab
diagnostic_definitions.maximum_capacity_utilisation: maximum post-shock selected attempts / shared capacity 26
diagnostic_definitions.maximum_simultaneous_active_backlog_fami: maximum families with post-execution backlog above 1e-9 DAI
diagnostic_definitions.maximum_simultaneously_unsafe_families: maximum number of candidate families before execution
diagnostic_definitions.mean_capacity_utilisation: mean post-shock selected attempts / shared capacity 26
diagnostic_definitions.share_hours_eth_wbtc_simultaneously_unsa: simultaneous ETH/WBTC unsafe hours / fixed 720-hour window

direction_normalisation.advantage: direction_multiplier * (portfolio - eth_only), where -1 denotes lower-is-better and +1 higher-is-better

empirical_gas_translation.translation_rule: preserve the exact selected 24-hour historical gas sequence at experiment hours 48-71 and retain the common ordinary sampled gas environment outside that interval

execution_plan.checkpoint_granularity: one replication containing all eight cells

horizon.price_translation_rule: prepend 24 ordinary hours, retain each registered 216-hour multiplier kernel byte-for-byte, then retain its terminal multiplier through the common horizon

identification_scope.limitation: B2 compares the two frozen registered joint-stress bundles. The smooth ETH and WBTC multiplier kernels co-move closely and differ in severity and recovery as registered, while the empirical treatment also owns its selected gas block. B2 therefore identifies deterioration across the registered bundles, not a pure causal correlation coefficient.

joint_empirical_stress_selection.selection_rule: maximum standardised ETH downside + standardised WBTC downside + 0.5 * standardised gas

outcome_definitions.active_bad_debt_share: terminal active bad debt / initial system debt
outcome_definitions.backlog_area_share: sum hourly post-shock unresolved tab / initial system debt
outcome_definitions.capacity_rejected_opportunities: sum post-shock demand selected minus shared-capacity attempts
outcome_definitions.debt_weighted_liquidated_vault_share: initial debt of unique post-shock liquidated vaults / initial debt
outcome_definitions.liquidated_debt_share: sum post-shock keeper-repaid debt / initial system debt
outcome_definitions.realised_bad_debt_share: sum post-shock realised bad debt / initial system debt
outcome_definitions.recovery_probability_720h: owned sustained-recovery indicator by 720 post-shock hours
outcome_definitions.successful_closure_count: sum post-shock fully liquidated vault closures
outcome_definitions.unresolved_tab_share: maximum post-shock unresolved liquidation tab / initial system debt

purpose: Test whether multi-collateral diversification persists, deteriorates or reverses under registered joint crypto stress.

uncertainty.binary_interaction_rule: interaction paired_probability_difference is the paired difference-in-differences; generic discordant counts are not applicable, while empirical and high-correlation source-pair discordant counts are retained separately
